name: guardians-lost-on-teleport-when-follow-travel-off
contract: With CoA.Guardians.FollowTravel = 0 a teleport to another map keeps today's behaviour: the core unsummons every guardian the player owns and nothing makes them again, so the Necromancer's two Life Force points become free and the Spirit Wolves are gone.

Players: An Undead Necromancer (class 23) with a Lesser Skeletal Warrior (500970, creature 50065) and a Ghoul (500971, creature 50073), 1 Life Force each, and an Orc Shaman with Feral Spirit (51533, two Spirit Wolves 29264, stock guardians that last 45 s and are summoned just before each travel). Counts are owned creatures within 100 yards (owned_creature_count); Life Force pool = stacks of 805011, free Life Force = stacks of 525004. Each check compares the value after a travel with a snapshot taken just before it, so the result does not depend on the pool size at level 20: the reported actual value is after minus before (for example -2 = two guardians lost).

Requires CoA.Guardians.FollowTravel = 0 in coa.conf (environment AC_CO_A_GUARDIANS_FOLLOW_TRAVEL=0 on a server without module configs). Expected on every build with the setting at 0: every check passes; on a build without the fix it passes as well, which is the point of the setting.

steps.label: Let login and the Life Force aura settle
SETUP: the Lesser Skeletal Warrior is out
Off: SETUP: two Spirit Wolves are out
Let the Life Force aura settle
Disabled: no skeleton after the teleport
Disabled: no ghoul after the teleport
Disabled: no Spirit Wolf after the teleport
Disabled: both Life Force points are free again
